messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-hosted-prod` (svc_91234). Trigger: high 5xx rate, region eu-west-1. Routing policy: `infra-primary` — page sent to infra-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-00421 created. Policy: infra-primary. Current escalation level: 1. Notified: infra-oncall.

Alice C.: whoa — that should have gone to `ml-inference-oncall`, not infra. ml team owns model-serving errors. Did PD service binding change? :thinking_face:

Ben P.: I saw the same. Quick check: recent PD config PR that touched schedule bindings last night (PR #4217). Could be a stale override.

Carla R.: pinging infra-oncall — if infra can't take, we need to reroute to ml. @infra-oncall are you able to ack and hand off?

infra-oncall (auto-reply): Acked on behalf of infra. Briefly investigating. Looks like pages for svc_91234 are bound to `infra-service` due to shadow schedule from `oncall-sync` job.

Morgan (ops): Customer reports coming in: a handful of tenants in eu-west-1 seeing 502/503 on inference endpoints since ~08:40 UTC. We should treat as P1 until we confirm blast radius. Logged: https://support.redwood/12345

Zane (sre): grabbing prod dashboard. I see spikes in 5xx at 08:39, CPU on gpu nodes fine, but pod restart churn + NLB 502s. Could be new traffic routing to a CPU-only pool (wrong variant) — aligns with service binding mismatch.

Alice C.: if PD routed wrong service, our autoscaler might have sent traffic to wrong node pool. Can someone check `k8s` deployment annotations and the routing rule in envoy for inference-hosted-prod? 

Ben P.: checking infra now. Quick command:
```
kubectl get svc inference-hosted-prod -n prod -o yaml | yq .metadata.annotations
```
Annotations show `redwood/pd-service: infra-service` which is wrong. Should be `ml-service`.

Carla R.: That's the stale PD binding. The oncall-sync job overwrote binding during schedule rotation. I'll push a manual fix to PD then reapply correct annotation.

Carla R.: (action) re-binding PD service -> `ml-inference-service` and patching k8s annotation now.

pagerduty-bot: PD service rebind initiated by Carla R. Action: change service for INC-2026-00421 to `ml-inference-oncall`.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: routing updated. New assignees: ml-inference-oncall.

Morgan (ops): Confirmed: traffic shifted back to gpu pool and 5xx rate dropping. Customers see successful requests again. Still monitoring. ETA to stable: 10m.

Zane (sre): Rolling restart of a few misrouted pods to clear bad cache: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n prod --field-selector=spec.nodeSelector` (targeted). Applied.

Alice C.: Thanks. Can we capture root cause: why did oncall-sync job overwrite the PD binding? Any config drift? 

Ben P.: quick look — the `oncall-sync` runs a reconcile that maps PD services to schedule IDs. There was a schedule rename last week; reconcile didn't match and defaulted to `infra-service`. We need a safety check.

Carla R.: Filing follow-up: created ticket INFRA-2026-88 to add validation to oncall-sync and prevent defaulting to infra. Also: add a canary flag so PD binding changes require manual approval during rotation.

Morgan (ops): Customer impact: about 7 tenants experienced degraded inference for ~5–8 minutes. CS notified via incident channel and postman ticket. No data loss; just transient errors.

Zane (sre): Escalation: not needed. Incident severity downgraded to SEV2. Will include timeline in postmortem.

Alice C.: Oncall handoff: I'm documenting current state and handing to Zane for monitoring window. Zane, you have the bridge.

Zane (sre): Taking it. I'll keep the channel open for 30m and watch for regressions. If 5xx < 0.1% for 30m, we'll close.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-00421 acknowledged by ml-inference-oncall (Zane). Escalation paused.

Carla R.: Postmortem notes to include: 1) cause: oncall-sync reconcile defaulting on unmatched schedule name, 2) impact: short routing to infra pool causing CPU-only traffic, 3) mitigation: manual PD rebind + pod restarts, 4) action items: INFRA-2026-88 + add unit test + PD change approval flow.

Alice C.: leaving a quick reproduction snippet for devs:
```
# simulate sync mismatch
curl -X POST https://oncall-sync/reconcile -d '{"schedule":"old-name"}'
# observe default binding
kubectl get svc inference-hosted-prod -n prod -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.redwood/pd-service}'
```

Morgan (ops): Noted. CS sent templated customer update. I'll coordinate follow-ups for affected tenants.

Zane (sre): Closing steps: monitor 30m, then we'll file RCA and close incident.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2026-00421 status changed to MONITORING.

Alice C.: thanks everyone. Follow-up owners: Carla (fix), Ben (tests), Zane (postmortem).
